visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three people are positioned in a music-themed room, each associated with a number (1, 2, 3). On the left, a man in a red sweater sits at a grand piano, moving his hands and arms across the keys. In the center, a woman in a striped shirt and denim overalls mimics playing an electronic keyboard. On the right, a woman in a blue crop top and leggings holds a silver flute to her mouth, swaying and moving her fingers as if playing along to the music. The room is brightly lit with music notes decorated on the walls. (2) The scene cuts to a slightly closer shot of the same setting. All three continue their synchronized mimicry of playing the classical piano piece. The woman with the flute moves her head and body expressively to the rhythm. (3) The music reaches a natural pause, and the performers stop their actions. The woman on the right (Number 3) smiles broadly, lowers her flute, and gestures with her hands towards the others. They all break character, looking at the camera with satisfied expressions as text overlays appear.

The purpose is to engage the audience in a 'guess who is actually playing' game, which is revealed to be a joke at the end as all three are likely just mimicking the professional recording.
